title: Blend vial tracking and Protocol polish

changes.title: Open and reconstitute premixed blend vials
changes.detail: Stash now offers an Open vial action with BAC water, expiry and vial notes for blends such as Deadpool.

changes.title: Log premixed blends as one item
changes.detail: Today dose selection treats premixed blends as a single entry, without creating new individual ingredient dose records.

changes.title: Cleaner Protocol steps
changes.detail: The protocol name field fits within the sheet and phase controls have consistent touch sizes and labels.

dataImpact: No automatic migration, deletion or change to existing dose history. New premixed blend doses are recorded under the blend name; old ingredient records are preserved. Opening a vial updates only its selected kit and vial metadata.
limitations: Physical iPhone and VoiceOver acceptance are pending.
